files.contents:
Saffi & Rue serves family-style platters, which suits six people, and it has the earliest slot. It also has vegetarian and nut-free dishes on the set menu.

files.contents:
$49 set menu per person

Corner booth by the window, seated for 2 hours. Six sharing platters, bread and dessert are included. Drinks are extra.

{#snippet actions()} (reserved = true)} /> ask('Other open times for six at Saffi & Rue on Saturday, Nov 7', 'Other times')} /> {/snippet}

files.name: lib/Guests.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
  import { Section, List, ListRow, Action } from 'design';
  import PaperPlaneTilt from 'phosphor-svelte/lib/PaperPlaneTilt';
  import Check from 'phosphor-svelte/lib/Check';

  let sent = $state(false);

  const guests = [
    { name: 'You', sub: 'Host · holding the booking', status: 'Coming' },
    { name: 'Mara Quint', sub: 'Arriving from work, may be 10 min late', status: 'Coming' },
    { name: 'Dev Okafor', sub: 'No nuts', status: 'Coming' },
    { name: 'Lena Ruiz', sub: 'Vegetarian', status: 'Coming' },
    { name: 'Tomas Hale', sub: 'Driving, will park at Merrow Lane', status: 'Coming' },
    { name: 'Priya Anand', sub: 'Has not replied yet', status: 'Pending' }
  ];
</script>

<Section title="Guests" kicker="5 of 6 confirmed">
  <List>
    {#each guests as g, i}
      <ListRow
        index={i + 1}
        label={g.name}
        sub={g.sub}
        trailing={sent && g.status === 'Pending' ? 'Reminded' : g.status}
      />
    {/each}
  </List>
  {#snippet actions()}
    <Action
      label={sent ? 'Details sent' : 'Send details to all'}
      sublabel={sent ? 'Time, address and the cost split' : 'Reminds Priya too'}
      icon={sent ? Check : PaperPlaneTilt}
      primary
      disabled={sent}
      onclick={() => (sent = true)}
    />
  {/snippet}
</Section>
